node.title: Re: Error while using click and click_button of WWW::Mechanize
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: That button calls a JavaScript function, and [mod://WWW::Mechanize] doesn't support JavaScript. See the section on JavaScript in the [mod://WWW::Mechanize::FAQ], and have a look at modules such as [mod://WWW::Mechanize::Firefox] or [mod://WWW::Mechanize::Chrome] instead.
